title: Aqua-Leisure Industries Recalls Inflatable Baby Floats Due to Drowning Hazard
summary: The leg straps in the seat of the float can tear, causing children to unexpectedly fall into or under the water, posing a risk of drowning. Units: About 4 Million.

title: Simplicity Drop Side Cribs Recalled by Retailers Due to Risk of Death from Suffocation
summary: The crib's plastic hardware can break or deform, causing the drop side to detach. When the drop side detaches, it creates space between the drop side and the crib mattress. title: Intermatic Recalls In-Wall Timers Due to Shock Hazard
summary: When consumers trying to replace the timer's battery place a metal object through the battery tray slot, the object can reach internal metal contacts, posing a shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 240,000.

title: Lamps Recalled by LTD Commodities LLC, ABC Distributing and the Lakeside Collection Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The lamps overheat, causing the vinyl coating on the cord to burst and melt, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About  25,800.

title: Polaris Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Loss of Control Hazard
summary: Bolts on the rear suspension can break causing the rail tip to become dislodged and interfere with the snowmobile's track. This can cause the track to lock up and the rider to lose control of the snowmobile, posing a risk of injury. Units: About 800.

title: Tabletop Rope Cutters Recalled by MarineTech Products Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The recalled rope cutters can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 450.

title: Butterfly Chairs Recalled by Hobby Lobby Stores Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The chair legs can detach unexpectedly causing the chair to collapse, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 500.

title: Children's Hooded Jackets with Drawstrings Recalled by EMH Associates Due to Entrapment Hazard
summary: The jackets have a drawstring around the waist which can pose an entrapment hazard to children. Units: About 4,400.

title: Evenflo Recalls Telephone Toys Due to Choking Hazard
summary: A mirror decal attached to the toy can peel away, posing a potential choking hazard. Units: About 25,000.

title: Leather Shag Rugs Recalled by Chandra Rugs Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The rugs fail to meet federal flammability standard, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 400.

title: Steam Cleaners Recalled by Thane International Due to Shock and Burn Hazards
summary: The power cord can unexpectedly wear down and expose the wiring, posing a shock and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 580,000.

title: Children's Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Recalled by Pro-Pac Distributing Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The sweatshirts have a drawstring through the hood which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 7,000.

title: Energizer Wallplate Nightlights Recalled Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The nightlight can overheat, especially if additional devices are plugged into its outlets, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,000.

title: Rossignol Recalls Cross-Country Boots Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The boot's sole could separate from the upper boot during use, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 3,000 pairs in the United States and 1,000 pairs in Canada.

title: American Greetings Corp. Recalls Sport Balls Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The surface coating on the basketball contains excessive levels of lead, in violation of the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 90,000 packages in the United States and 1,900 in Canada.

title: Bosch Thermotechnology Recalls Boilers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: An electrical connector can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 90.

title: Children's Hooded Jackets and Pullover Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Recalled by Hard Tail Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The jackets and pullovers have a drawstring through the hood or waist which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 130.

title: Children's Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Recalled by C-Mrk Inc. Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The hooded sweatshirts have a drawstring through the hood which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 725.

title: Kidde Recalls Dual Sensor Smoke Alarms; Can Fail to Warn of a Fire
summary: An electrostatic discharge can damage the unit, causing it not to warn consumers of a fire. Units: About 94,000.

title: Tea Kettles Recalled by Wilton Industries Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The lid on the tea kettle can come loose during handling, posing a burn hazard to the consumer. Units: About 142,000.

title: Husqvarna Recalls Lawn Tractors; Parking Brake Failure Can Cause Loss of Control
summary: The tractor's parking brake can fail posing a loss of control hazard. Units: About 8,200.

title: Kolcraft Recalls 1 Million Play Yards Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The play yard's side rail can fail to latch properly and when a child pushes against the rail it can unlatch unexpectedly, posing a fall hazard to children. Units: About 1 million.

title: BioSensory Recalls Dragonfly II Mosquito Trap and NightWatch Bedbug Monitor Products Due to Laceration or Burn Hazard
summary: Carbon dioxide (CO2) pressure sensors inside these products can crack and leak or burst causing the release of CO2. This could cause cracks with sharp edges that could cut a consumer's hand, or direct CO2 discharge could cause a frostbite-like burn to a consumer's hand. Units: 70 Mosquito Traps; and

title: Pacifiers Recalled by Gromex Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The pacifier mouth guard and the ventilation holes are too small and fail to meet federal safety standards. The pacifier could pose a choking and aspiration hazard to young children. Units: About 700.

title: Women's Shoes Recalled by Charles David Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Nordstrom and Nordstrom Rack
summary: The heel of the recalled shoes can detach, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 3,200 pairs.

title: Bass Amplifiers Recalled by Fender Musical Instruments Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The recalled amplifier's wiring can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 90.

title: Bed Steps Recalled by Domestications Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bed steps can break during use, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 780.

title: Boy's Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings and Warm up Sets Recalled by Burlington Coat Factory Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The sweatshirts and jackets to the warm up sets have drawstrings through the hoods, posing a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 13,300.

title: Frigidaire Recalls Clothes Washers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: An internal defect in the washer's drain pump can cause heat to build up, posing a fire hazard to the consumer. Units: About 35,000.

title: Little Tikes Recalls Clubhouse Swing Sets Due to Fall Hazard; New Assembly Directions to Be Provided
summary: The recalled swing sets did not come with assembly directions for the swing seat harness. The swing seat harness assembly needs to be completed by the consumer. The swing seats can detach if the harness is not assembled properly, which could result in fall and injury during use. Units: About 1,950.

title: Sherwin-Williams Recalls Purdy Scrapers Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The recalled scraper's body can break away from the handle when struck against a hard object. This poses a laceration hazard to users. Units: About 76,000.

title: BabySwede LLC Recalls Bouncer Chairs Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: Small sharp metal objects found in the padded area of the bouncer chair can protrude, posing a laceration hazard to children. Units: About 6,500.

title: Blitz USA Recalls Enviro-Flo(tm) Plus Fuel Containers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The spout's plunger cap can dislodge which can open the seal of the fuel container and allow gasoline vapors to escape. This could cause liquid gasoline to spill from the top of the container during use and result in a fire hazard. Units: About 4,000.

title: Reflections of Magic Mirrors Recalled By Lyne Yi International Due to Impact and Laceration Hazards
summary: The metal plate used for hanging the mirror can become detached and cause the mirror to fall, posing an impact or laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 600.

title: LeapFrog Recalls Electronic Plush Toys Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The decals on the paws of the plush toy can be removed and ingested by a child, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 3,700.

title: Sevca LLC Recalls Sevylor(R) Tow Behinds; Quick Hitch Connectors Break, Posing Serious Hazard to Users
summary: The Quick Hitch, which connects the towable to the boat, can break and project pieces of the plastic Quick Hitch back towards the boat. If this occurs, an individual can be struck and seriously injured. Units: About 94,000.

title: Violation of Federal Mattress Flammability Standard Prompts Recall of Mattresses by Foamorder.com
summary: The foam blocks with cotton covers (intended to be used as mattresses) fail to meet the mandatory federal open flame standard for mattresses, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 140.

title: Polaris Industries Recalls ATVs Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The valve assembly can fail in freezing temperatures, causing oil to leak into the exhaust system. This could pose a fire and burn hazard to the rider. Units: About 4,700.

title: Buster Brown Clog Children's Shoes Recalled by Brown Shoe Co. and Pagoda International Footwear Ltd. Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The shoe has decorative wheels that can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1.4 million (This recall was first announced in Apr. 2009).

title: Elliptical Exercise Gliders Recalled by Thane Due to Fall Hazard; New Instructions to Be Provided
summary: The written instructions incorrectly identify the proper location of the spring washer. An incorrectly installed spring washer can put undue stress on bolts, causing them to loosen, which poses a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 48,000.

title: Fiesta Recalls to Repair Gas Grills Due to Fire, Burn Hazards
summary: The hose of the gas tank can get too close to the firebox and be exposed to heat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 88,000 units in the United States and 25,000 in Canada.

title: Heating System Thermostats Recalled by OJ Electronics Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The recalled thermostat's floor sensor or its cable can be damaged from cutting, drilling, or nailing. This poses a risk of electric shock to consumers if the power supply is not disconnected. Units: About 30,000.

title: LEGO Systems Announces Recall of Remote Controls Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The batteries in the remote controls can overheat, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,600.

title: Stamina Products Recalls Elliptical Machines; Provides New Warning and Assembly Instructions
summary: Stamina modified the warning/assembly instructions in the owner's manuals to emphasize that the elliptical pedal shafts must be securely tightened to the cranks.
